summary: Creates a central place to record the IPv6 interface identifiers and ranges that other RFCs have reserved or given special meaning, since a node that automatically picks an identifier in one of those ranges could get unexpected results. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Some house numbers are saved for special uses. This memo makes one list of those special numbers so nobody grabs one by accident.

questions: which ipv6 interface ids are reserved
